## Which jar? Match your Minecraft version

Every jar here is named `xaerotools-companion-<release>+<minecraft>.jar`. The
part after the `+` is the Minecraft version — that is the only part you need to
match; the number before it is just this release.

| Minecraft | Download the jar ending in |
|---|---|
| 1.21.4 | `+1.21.4.jar` |
| 1.21.5 | `+1.21.5.jar` |
| 1.21.6 | `+1.21.6.jar` |
| 1.21.7 | `+1.21.7.jar` |
| 1.21.8 | `+1.21.8.jar` |
| 1.21.9 or 1.21.10 | `+1.21.10.jar` |
| 1.21.11 | `+1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1.x | `+26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.2.x | `+26.2.jar` |

## Install — 3 steps

1. **Download one jar** from the table (you need Fabric with
   [Meteor Client](https://meteorclient.com/) and Xaero's World Map).
2. **Drop it into your `mods` folder** and start the game.
3. **Open the XaeroTools tab** in Meteor's top bar —
   [setup guide](https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools-companion#setup).

Works with any
[XaeroTools](https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools/releases/latest) release
0.2 or newer. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies your download.
